text: D229975 review accepts while asking the URL validator to include the invalid URL for easier diagnosis. The actual historical and fixed getNativeTabProperties code distinguish a missing URL from an invalid resolved URL and include the latter value in the thrown error. Keep this narrow API-boundary diagnostic when changing the converter. This is not permission to log message bodies or arbitrary sensitive inputs, and no invalid-URL runtime was executed.
title: Include the rejected space URL in its boundary error
